steps.name: DESeq2 LRT: condition:time interaction (treatment-specific time trend)
caveats: With only 3 replicates per condition x time cell, DESeq2 count-outlier detection (Cook's distance) sets p-values to NA per cell rather than replacing counts (that behavior triggers only at >=7 replicates/cell) — report these NA genes separately from independent-filtering NAs so the cause of each missing p-value is traceable.
A gene absent from the LRT-significant list is not evidence that its time trajectory is the same between conditions — it may simply reflect low power at n=3/cell.
steps.context: 24 samples, 2 conditions x 4 timepoints (t0-t3), n=3 per cell, raw integer counts from salmon (no transcript-level tximport inputs available — only gene-level counts.csv was supplied, so median-of-ratios normalization runs directly on the provided gene-level integer counts).

steps.description: Pre-filter genes to at least 10 counts in at least 3 samples (smallest cell size). This tests, for each gene, whether its time trajectory differs between the two conditions beyond a trend shared by both — the direct answer to the research question. Extract results with BH-adjusted p-values at alpha=0.05, with independent filtering on. Separately, for reporting context (not as the primary test), extract the per-condition simple time effects and apeglm-shrunk log2 fold changes for the individual condition:time interaction coefficients. Report the count of DESeq2 count-outlier NA flags and the independent-filtering NA count separately, and plot the p-value histogram before adjustment.

plan.title: Interaction DE: treatment-specific time trend beyond shared time
plan.analytical_narrative: The metadata profile is a 2-condition x 4-timepoint (t0-t3) design with n=3 per cell (24 samples, 12000 genes), raw salmon gene-level counts. The research question — which genes change over time in a treatment-specific way, beyond the trend shared by both conditions — is exactly the DESeq2 likelihood-ratio-test time-course design: fit the full model ~condition+time+condition:time against the reduced model ~condition+time. Genes significant in this LRT have a time profile that differs by condition; a Wald test on a single interaction coefficient would only capture one pairwise time-contrast and miss curvature differences. Track T1 runs sample-structure QC, then the count-based DESeq2 LRT with pre-filtering and BH-adjusted significance, then apeglm-shrunk fold changes for the reporting table, then k-means/hierarchical trajectory clustering of the LRT-significant genes' condition-specific z-scored time profiles. Track T2 takes the LRT gene ranking (by -log10(p) signed by an approximate direction, since the LRT itself yields no single-coefficient sign) into a preranked GSEA against MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome, both staged and human-matched, to describe which coordinated programs carry the treatment-specific time signal. A final report step assembles diagnostics, gene tables, cluster trajectories, and enrichment with all reproducibility fields and the explicit power caveat for n=3/cell in an interaction/LRT design (rules R-0013, R-0014, R-0063, R-0017, R-0094 from the grounding pass all flag this directly).
